description.narrative: A new mechanism where the tripartite constituents effectively meet in order to plan and adopt normative action was formally established during the biennium. Meetings occur at least once a year. Dando seguimiento a las medidas adoptadas en el marco de la iniciativa relativa a las normas en noviembre de 2020, se instaló la mesa de dialogo para dar tratamiento a una reclamación presentada en septiembre de 2020 en virtud del artículo 24 de la Constitución alegando incumplimiento del Convenio sobre la seguridad social (norma mínima), 1952 (núm. 102). En diciembre de 2021 ambas partes informaron que continua el proceso de conciliación y solicitaron una prórroga de 6 meses para continuar dicho proceso. La Oficina ha suministrado asistencia técnica en este proceso.

description.narrative:
CEACR Observation on C 87 - Mexico
"The Committee notes with satisfaction that this Decree introduces the following amendments to the Federal Act on State Employees ( LFTSE): (i) it repeals section 68 (which established that there would be only one union in each agency); and (ii) it amends section 69 (removing the ban on trade unionists leaving the union of which they have become members and introducing the right of workers to join and establish unions without prior authorization), section 71 (removing from the requirements for establishing a union the fact that "there is no other union group with a greater number of members within the same state agency"), section 73 (removing the reference to "when a different union group that is in the majority is registered" as grounds for the dissolution of the union), section 79 (removing the prohibition on unions of public servants joining trade union organizations of workers or rural workers) and section 84 (removing the reference to the Federation of Unions of State Employees as the single central trade union recognized by the State).
It is to be highlighted that the repeated comments of the supervisory bodies over a number of years resulted in the Government's action on amending the provisions which were not in compliance with the provisions of the Convention. In its comments, the Committee of Experts (CEACR) asked the Government to take measures to amend the provisions that limit trade union pluralism in state agencies and the possibility of the re-election of union officials: sections 68, 69, 71, 72, 73, 75, 79 and 84 of the Federal Act on State Employees (LFTSE), and the legislative declaration establishing the trade union monopoly of the National Federation of Banking Unions (FENASIB). As a result, the Government did pass a Decree that introduced the requested amendments to the Federal Act on State Employees ( LFTSE), which was noted with satisfaction by the CEACR.

description.narrative: El 3 julio de 2020, el gobierno de México, representado por la titular de la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social (STPS), depositó ante la OIT el Convenio núm. 189 sobre el Trabajo Doméstico, con lo que México cuenta ya con 81 Convenios Internacionales del Trabajo ratificados. El Decreto Promulgatorio del Convenio 189 se publicó en el Diario Oficial de la Federación el 2 de julio del 2021. El Convenio fue aprobado por la Cámara de Senadores el 12 de diciembre de 2019 y el Decreto publicado en el Diario Oficial de la Federación del 21 de enero de 2020. La OIT brindó asistencia técnica al Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social (IMSS), la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social y otros actores para la elaboración de un modelo de largo plazo para la afiliación obligatoria de trabajadoras del hogar al seguro social mexicano. Esta asistencia comprendió la preparación de recomendaciones técnicas a lo largo del año 2020, para identificar brechas entre un piloto de afiliación público y las garantías establecidas por el Convenio núm. 189. Como resultado, el piloto fue corregido y comenzó a operar a partir de noviembre de 2020. Las recomendaciones de OIT se basaron en un estudio denominado "Doce recomendaciones para el programa de trabajadoras del hogar en el IMSS", que fue elaborado a finales del 2019 por la Oficina en colaboración con Nacional Monte de Piedad. Adicionalmente, este proceso permitió darle mayor visibilidad a la situación de las trabajadoras domésticas y potenciar la capacidad del estado para generar respuestas a partir de la normativa laboral internacional.

description.narrative: The Office received all due article 22 reports (including replies to the CEACR's comments) on all 27 Conventions within the deadline. On 4 February 2021, the office held a virtual workshop on 4 February 2021 for the officials of the Secretariat of Labour and Social Security in which it provided advice and assistance on reporting obligations and on the specific reports and replies to the CEACR's comments. The workshop dealt with all pending comments on the following Conventions due in 2021. The Conventions which were dealt with are numbers 12, 13, 14, 17, 19, 30, 42, 43, 45, 49, 52, 87, 95, 98, 106, 115, 118, 120, 131, 144, 150, 153, 155, 160, 161, 167, 170 and 173. Moreover, during the period from 28 June 2021 to 30 July 2021, the Office organized an online course on reporting during the ILS Academy for Latin America-designed for the tripartite constituents. Five participants from Mexico from the Ministry of Labour and Social Security attended, two employer delegates and one worker delegate. The course included (1) three interactive self-guided modules linked to article 22 reporting (Reports under articles 22 and 19 of the ILO Constitution, the CEACR, and the CAS); (2) a specific live session on sharing art. 22 reporting practices; (3) an Internet demonstration, showing how to find reporting calendars, report forms, reporting tools and resources; (4) a substantive session on C87 and C98 (reports provided by Mexico in 2021); (5) a substantive session on the instruments covered by the upcoming General Survey.
